notes.title: Small changes and fixes
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.36.0 brings a few bugs fixes (thx grahfstampede for reporting them):
1) When you die all quests become available from the NPCs again, even though you still have the quests from before you died 
2) You can then drag projectile from your hot-bar to the ground to create 1 of them out of thin air
3) If your inventory is full and you step on an item which would stack with an item already in your inventory it still says your inventory is full 

New feature:
Main attributes now have a tooltip describing whet they are used for

Stay tuned next update (1st Anniversary) will be a big one!

notes.title: Version 0.8.9.1
notes.notes:
Technical update:
- possibility to set Vsync (user request)
- possibility to set Resolution
- game playable also at Ultra Wide resolutions (5120x1440 and above)

notes.title: Version 0.8.8.9 - New enemy, Hooch consumption effect
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.8.9

New enemy: Vampire, you guessed it, he is thirsty!
Two new achievements: "Archery Master", "Melee_Master"
Hooch drunk effect: view is floating!

notes.title: Version 0.8.8.7 - small enhancements
notes.notes:
Changes:
- Craft Panel: increased room for recipes (at the cost of lower loot items grid)
- 'Merge and upgrade recipe' now adds a suffix : (Upgraded) to the equipment
- Possibility to undo temporarily assigned Exp points
- Two new achievements added: Champions Destroyer, Bosses Destroyer
